$comment: LENGTH story problems (Year pages AB, 2026-11-14; 2.MD.B.5: add and subtract within 100 to solve word problems involving lengths given in the same units). Read by types/_shared/length-stories.js. Every frame names its own thing (so no word has to agree with another), and its unit: `small` things in inches (en) or centimeters, `long` things in feet (en) or meters. Slots: {n1} {n2} {n3} the lengths the story tells, {name} a child, {il} the pronoun of {name} (fr). Kinds: add (two lengths put together), sub (a length taken away), cmpDiff (how much longer), cmpMore (so much longer: how long), cmpLess (so much shorter: how long), subChange (how much was taken away). A frame's `thing` names its picture. No rope: the library has no picture of one (its "rope" is a tool).
